title: Fix the flyer
prompt:
Night Jay's hackathon flyer prints a line that somebody boring snuck in.

In JavaScript, // starts a comment: the rest of the line is skipped.

Comment out the line about lights out, and leave the rest alone. The program should print exactly:

HACKATHON NIGHT!!!
Sat + Sun nights, Student Union
Free pizza!!!
hints: Put // at the start of a line and JavaScript skips the whole line, but the code is still there if you want it back.
Change the third console.log to: // console.log("Lights out at 10 p.m. Please be quiet.");

tests.expected_stdout:
HACKATHON NIGHT!!!
Sat + Sun nights, Student Union
Free pizza!!!
